Fantasy Props MegaKit

A downloadable asset pack

Download NowName your own price

The Fantasy Props MEGAKIT is a pack of over 200 medieval props, ranging from weapons and tools to vegetables, potions, market stalls, chests, furniture, and more. Each model was carefully crafted using as few textures as possible for optimization (all 200 models use just 4 texture sets), and meshes with low poly counts. In the Source and Pro versions, models also include custom simple collisions and worn texture variants, effectively doubling the number of models.

Features:

  • 200+ Unique models in a wide variety of categories (furniture, tools, weapons, books, potions, breakables, etc)
  • Optimized models with low poly counts and shared texture sets
  • Source version comes with all 200+ assets already implemented in Unity (URP), Unreal and Godot with custom shaders.
  • Source version also has custom simple collisions and worn texture variants for each model.
  • Wizard's Den preview scene from the Trailer is included in the Source version.
  • Free to use in personal, educational and commercial projects. (CC0 License)
  • .FBX, .OBJ and .glTF formats, compatible with all engines.
